def replay_html(replay):
    """The replay as a page for a browser: the result on top, then each thread's e-mails in order."""
    e, r = html.escape, replay["result"]

    def sheet(terms, caption=""):
        cap = f"<caption class='tag'>{e(caption)}</caption>" if caption else ""
        rows = "".join(f"<tr><td>{e(NAMES.get(k, k))}</td><td>{e(_fmt(v))}</td></tr>" for k, v in terms.items())
        return f"<table>{cap}{rows}</table>"

    money = {k: "-" if r[k] is None else f"{r[k]:,.2f}" for k in ("c_open", "c_deal", "c_best")}
    head = f"Deal with {r['supplier_id']}" if r["deal"] else "No deal"
    out = [
        f"<h1>Replay {e(replay['session_id'])} - {e(replay['case_id'])}</h1><h2>{e(head)}</h2><table>",
        *(f"<tr><th>{k}</th><td>{v}</td></tr>" for k, v in money.items()),
        f"<tr><th>score</th><td>{r['score']:.3f}</td></tr></table>",
        sheet(r["terms"], f"agreed terms ({r['offer_id']})") if r["deal"] else "",
    ]
    for sup, messages in replay["threads"].items():
        out.append(f"<h2>Thread with {e(sup)}</h2>")
        for m in messages:
            buyer = m.get("from") == "buyer"
            status = "" if buyer else f" <span class='tag'>{e(str(m.get('status')))}</span>"
            out.append(f"<div class='mail {'buyer' if buyer else 'supplier'}'>")
            out.append(f"<div><span class='who'>{e(str(m.get('from')))}</span>{status}</div>")
            out.append(f"<div class='tag'>{e(str(m.get('subject', '')))}</div>")
            out.append(f"<div class='body'>{e(str(m.get('body', '')))}</div>")
            for t in m.get("term_sheets") or []:
                out.append(sheet(t.get("terms", {}), t.get("term_sheet_id") or "term sheet"))
            if m.get("action"):
                out.append(f"<div class='tag'>action: {e(json.dumps(m['action']))}</div>")
            if m.get("attachments"):
                out.append(f"<div class='tag'>attached: {e(', '.join(a['name'] for a in m['attachments']))}</div>")
            out.append("</div>")
    title = f"Replay {replay['session_id']}"
    return (
        f"<!doctype html><html lang='en'><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>{e(title)}</title>"
        f"<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1'><style>{PAGE_CSS}</style></head>"
        f"<body>{''.join(out)}</body></html>"
    )


def create_app(sim):
    from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
    from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, Response

    app = FastAPI(title="arena-sim")

    @app.middleware("http")
    async def size_limit(request: Request, call_next):
        if int(request.headers.get("content-length") or 0) > MAX_BODY:
            return JSONResponse({"detail": "request body too large"}, 413)
        return await call_next(request)

    @app.exception_handler(Fail)
    async def failed(_, e: Fail):
        return JSONResponse({"detail": e.detail}, e.status, headers=e.headers)

    def team_of(request, post=False):
        key = request.headers.get("x-api-key", "")
        if key not in sim.teams:
            raise Fail(401, "missing or unknown X-API-Key")
        if post:
            now, calls = time.monotonic(), sim.calls.setdefault(key, [])
            calls[:] = [t for t in calls if now - t < 1]
            if len(calls) >= MAX_CALLS:
                raise Fail(429, f"more than {MAX_CALLS} calls per second", {"Retry-After": "1"})  # as the arena
            calls.append(now)
        return key

    def act(request, req, fn):
        """One POST: authenticated, rate-limited, answered from the store when retried."""
        with sim.lock:
            team, move_id = team_of(request, post=True), request.headers.get("x-move-id")
            digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([request.url.path, req], sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
            if move_id and (team, move_id) in sim.replies:
                seen, reply = sim.replies[(team, move_id)]
                if seen != digest:
                    raise Fail(422, "X-Move-Id was already used for a different request")
                return reply
            reply = fn(team)
            if move_id:
                sim.replies[(team, move_id)] = (digest, reply)
            return reply

    def read(request, fn):
        with sim.lock:
            return fn(team_of(request))

    @app.get("/health")
    def health():
        return {"ok": True}

    @app.post("/v1/register")
    def register(body: dict):
        with sim.lock:
            if body.get("event_code") != sim.code:
                raise Fail(403, "wrong event code")
            if body.get("team_name") in sim.teams.values():
                raise Fail(409, "team name already registered")
            key = hashlib.sha256(f"{body.get('team_name')}{time.time()}".encode()).hexdigest()
            sim.teams[key] = body.get("team_name")
            return {"team_id": f"team-{key[:8]}", "api_key": key}

    @app.get("/v1/cases")
    def cases(request: Request, set: str = "practice"):
        if set == "final":
            raise Fail(403, "the final window is not open")
        return read(request, lambda t: [{**c, "hosted": True} for c in sim.cases.values()])

    @app.post("/v1/sessions")
    def create(request: Request, body: dict, response: Response):
        reply = act(request, body, lambda t: sim.open(t, body.get("case_id")))
        response.headers[REMAINING] = str(read(request, sim.practice)["left"])
        return reply

    @app.get("/v1/me")
    def me(request: Request):
        def fn(t):
            best = {}
            for x in sim._mine(t):
                if x["result"]:
                    best[x["case"]["case_id"]] = max(best.get(x["case"]["case_id"], 0), x["result"]["score"])
            return {"team_name": sim.teams[t], "status": "active", "practice": sim.practice(t), "best": best}

        return read(request, fn)

    @app.get("/v1/sessions")
    def sessions(request: Request, set: str = "practice"):
        keep = ("case_id", "status", "end_reason", "rounds")
        return read(
            request,
            lambda t: [
                {
                    **{k: sim.state(t, s["id"])[k] for k in keep},
                    "session_id": s["id"],
                    **{k: (s["result"] or {}).get(k) for k in ("deal", "score")},
                    "created_at": s["created_at"],
                }
                for s in sim._mine(t)
            ],
        )

    @app.get("/v1/sessions/{sid}")
    def state(request: Request, sid: str):
        return read(request, lambda t: sim.state(t, sid))

    @app.post("/v1/sessions/{sid}/threads/{sup}/messages")
    def message(request: Request, sid: str, sup: str, body: dict):
        return act(request, body, lambda t: sim.message(t, sid, sup, body.get("message") or {}))

    @app.get("/v1/sessions/{sid}/threads/{sup}")
    def thread(request: Request, sid: str, sup: str):
        return read(request, lambda t: sim.thread(t, sid, sup))

    @app.get("/v1/sessions/{sid}/attachments/{att}")
    def attachment(request: Request, sid: str, att: str):
        data, media = read(request, lambda t: sim.attachment(t, sid, att))
        return Response(data, media_type=media)

    @app.get("/v1/sessions/{sid}/backoffice")
    def backoffice(request: Request, sid: str):
        def fn(t):
            if sim.state(t, sid)["status"] != "ended":
                raise Fail(403, "the back office shows after the case ends")
            return [{"from": "sales", "to": "team", "text": "The simulator has no back office."}]

        return read(request, fn)

    @app.post("/v1/sessions/{sid}/moves")
    def move(request: Request, sid: str, body: dict):
        def fn(t):  # the structured path: an offer is an e-mail with one term sheet
            m = body.get("move") or {}
            if m.get("type") != "offer":
                raise Fail(422, "a move has type 'offer'; use /accept or /walk_away to close")
            refs = [r for c in m.get("claims", []) for r in c.get("refs", [])]
            msg = {"body": m.get("text", ""), "refs": refs, "term_sheets": [{"terms": m.get("terms", {})}]}
            reply = sim.message(t, sid, body.get("supplier_id", ""), msg)
            out = structured(reply, sim.sessions[sid]["threads"][body["supplier_id"]]["round"])
            sim.sessions[sid]["moves"].append({"supplier_id": body["supplier_id"], "move": m, "reply": out})
            return out

        return act(request, body, fn)

    @app.post("/v1/sessions/{sid}/accept")
    def accept(request: Request, sid: str, body: dict):
        def fn(t):
            owner = next(
                (k for k, th in sim.session(t, sid)["threads"].items() if th["offer_id"] == body.get("offer_id")), ""

def closing_terms(case, terms, standard=None):

    its quote PDF) for anything left out, then the case's fixed terms; gaps from the buyer's plan.

def horizon_start(case):

    return date.fromisoformat(first) if first else None


def _years(case, t):
    """Years of the horizon a deal covers; a single order (0 months) counts as one year's lot.
    A commitment beyond the horizon neither costs nor earns."""
    months = t["contract_months"]
    return min(months / 12 if months else 1.0, case["buyer"]["horizon_years"])


def _units_before(case, t, years):
    """Units bought between the horizon start and the date a new price takes effect."""
    start = horizon_start(case)
    if not t.get("effective_date") or start is None:
        return 0.0
    lag = (date.fromisoformat(t["effective_date"]) - start).days / 365
    return t["volume_per_year"] * min(max(lag, 0.0), years)


def supplier_value(case, terms, supplier):
    """What a deal is worth to the supplier per unit, in cash: the price at its standard terms that
    would pay it the same. `supplier` is your estimate of it:
      standard       its standard terms (quote PDF, `docs.standard_terms`)
      interest_rate  what money now is worth to it per year (more to a supplier short of cash)
      usual_rate     its usual cost of money (default: interest_rate); tooling paid up front is
                     worth more to it when cash is dearer than usual
      ppm            the defect rate it really achieves (default: its standard ppm commitment)
      extra          EUR per unit it gains (+) or spends (-) beyond these items, e.g. overtime for
                     a faster delivery or idle capacity a larger volume fills (default 0)
    Contract length and an index clause are security, not cash: they do not count here."""
    b, std = case["buyer"], {**supplier["standard"], **case.get("fixed_terms", {})}
    t = closing_terms(case, terms, std)
    years = _years(case, t)
    sold = t["volume_per_year"] * years
    old = _units_before(case, t, years) / sold  # sold at the current price
    rate = supplier["interest_rate"]
    pay = 1 - rate * (t["payment_days"] - std["payment_days"]) / 360
    cash_now = 1 + (rate - supplier.get("usual_rate", rate)) * years / 2
    freight = b["freight_eur_per_unit"]
    ppm = supplier.get("ppm", std.get("ppm_commitment") or 0)
    return (
        t["unit_price"] * (1 - old) * pay
        + old * (b.get("current_unit_price") or 0.0) * pay
        + freight[t["incoterm"]]
        - freight[std["incoterm"]]  # it carries the freight leg
        + ((t.get("tooling_eur") or 0) - (std.get("tooling_eur") or 0)) / sold * cash_now
        - ppm / 1e6 * ((t.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0) - (std.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0))
        + supplier.get("extra", 0.0)
    )


def _soft(gap):
    """Margin points below the sustainable margin, as they cost: none above it, quadratic over
    the first 5 points, linear beyond - no kink."""
    if gap <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return gap * gap / 10 if gap <= 5 else gap - 2.5


def relationship_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None, value=None):
    """Strategic and bottleneck goals only: EUR for every margin point the deal leaves the supplier
    below `sustainable_margin_pct`, per year covered. `supplier["full_cost"]` (EUR per unit) is your
    estimate of its full cost; `value` overrides `supplier_value`. Without an estimate: 0."""
    b = case["buyer"]
    per_point, sustainable = b.get("relationship_eur_per_point"), b.get("sustainable_margin_pct")
    if b.get("category_goal") not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS or not per_point or not sustainable or not supplier:
        return 0.0
    t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
    worth = value if value is not None else supplier_value(case, t, supplier)
    margin = (worth - supplier["full_cost"]) / worth * 100
    return per_point * _soft(sustainable - margin) * _years(case, t)


def cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
    """C by part. `standard`: the supplier's standard terms for anything the term sheet leaves out.
    `supplier`: your estimate of the supplier for the relationship term (`supplier_value`)."""
    b, t = case["buyer"], closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
    if t.get("unit_price") is None:
        raise ValueError("no unit_price: a term sheet without a price has no cost")
    years = _years(case, t)
    committed = t["volume_per_year"] * years  # bought, needed or not
    covered = min(t["volume_per_year"], b["need_per_year"]) * years
    pre = _units_before(case, t, years)
    at_new_price = (committed - pre) * t["unit_price"]
    spend = pre * (b.get("current_unit_price") or t["unit_price"]) + at_new_price
    per_defect = b.get("cost_per_defect", 0)
    defect_cost = per_defect - min(t.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0, per_defect)
    index = index_risk = 0.0
    if clause := t.get("index_clause"):
        path = b.get("index_paths", {}).get(clause["series"], 0.0)
        moved = max(0.0, abs(path) - clause["deadband_pct"] / 100)
        index = at_new_price * clause["material_share"] * moved * math.copysign(1, path)
        index_risk = at_new_price * clause["material_share"] * b.get("index_risk_pct", 0) / 100
    uncovered = (b["need_per_year"] * b["horizon_years"] - covered) * b["fallback_unit_price"]
    need = b["need_lead_time_days"]
    return {
        "price": spend,
        "uncovered_need": uncovered,
        "fallback_risk": uncovered * b.get("fallback_risk_pct", 0) / 100,
        "payment_terms": spend * b["interest_rate"] * (b["reference_payment_days"] - t["payment_days"]) / 360,
        "freight": committed * b["freight_eur_per_unit"][t["incoterm"]],
        "late_delivery": b.get("late_cost_per_day", 0) * max(0, t["lead_time_days"] - need),
        "quality": committed * (t.get("ppm_commitment") or 0) / 1e6 * defect_cost,
        "tooling": t.get("tooling_eur") or 0.0,
        "index_clause": index,
        "index_risk": index_risk,
        "relationship": relationship_cost(case, t, supplier=supplier),
    }


def total_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
    """C in EUR; infinite for terms without a price (e.g. a supplier that quotes none), so such a
    sheet is never the cheapest and never beats an alternative."""
    if closing_terms(case, terms, standard).get("unit_price") is None:
        return math.inf
    return round(sum(cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard, supplier).values()), 2)


def score(c_open, c_deal, c_best):
    if c_deal is None:
        return 0.0
    if c_open - c_best <= 0.01:  # no room to negotiate: matching the best is full marks
        return 1.0 if c_deal <= c_best + 0.01 else 0.0
    return min(1.0, max(0.0, (c_open - c_deal) / (c_open - c_best)))


def must_haves_ok(case, terms, standard=None):
    t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
    for m in case["buyer"].get("must_haves", []):
        value = t.get(m["field"])
        if value is None and m["op"] not in ("==", "!="):
            return False
        if not OPS[m["op"]](value, m["value"]):
            return False
    return True


def snap(case, field, value):
    """The allowed value closest to `value` (case `term_options`), else `value` unchanged."""
    options = case.get("term_options", {}).get(field)
    if not options or value in options:
        return value
    if isinstance(value, int | float) and all(isinstance(o, int | float) for o in options):
        return min(options, key=lambda o: (abs(o - value), o))
    return options[0]


def complete_offer(case, terms):
    """A valid term sheet: exactly the negotiable fields, gaps from the buyer's plan, snapped."""
    plan = closing_terms(case, {"unit_price": None})
    freight = case["buyer"]["freight_eur_per_unit"]
    plan["incoterm"] = min(freight, key=freight.get)  # when asking, ask for the cheapest freight
    out = {}
    for field in case["negotiable"]:
        value = terms.get(field, plan.get(field))
        if value is None and case.get("term_options", {}).get(field):
            value = case["term_options"][field][0]
        value = snap(case, field, value)
        out[field] = round(value, 2) if field == "unit_price" and value is not None else value
    return out
"""`arena` command line: register, list cases, play one case or a whole set, show the board,
run the MCP server."""

import argparse
import functools
import io
import json
import logging
import os
import statistics
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from .client import ArenaClient, ArenaError
from .play import RemoteTable, hosted, play, play_all, play_waves


def load_env(path=".env"):
    """Read KEY=VALUE lines from .env into the environment (real env vars win)."""
    p = Path(path)
    if p.is_file():
        for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
            key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
            value = value.strip().strip("\"'")
            if sep and value and not key.strip().startswith("#"):
                os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value)


def agent_factory(name, data):
    from .agents import LLMAgent, NaiveAgent, llm_from_env

    if name == "naive":
        return NaiveAgent
    package = None
    if data:
        from .data import DataPackage

        package = DataPackage(data)
        package.lookup("")  # build the ID index once, before agents share it
    complete = llm_from_env()
    return lambda: LLMAgent(complete, package)


def summary(result):
    keep = ("deal", "supplier_id", "terms", "c_open", "c_deal", "c_best", "score")
    return {k: result.get(k) for k in keep if k in result}


def main(argv=None):
    load_env()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="arena")
    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true")
    verbose = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)  # -v also after the command
    verbose.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", default=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser = functools.partial(sub.add_parser, parents=[verbose])
    r = sub.add_parser(
        "register", help="arena-sim only: get a simulator key (the arena's key comes from the organisers)"
    )
    r.add_argument("team_name")
    r.add_argument("event_code")
    data = {"default": os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA"), "help": "data package folder"}
    sets = {"default": "practice", "help": "practice, final or sandbox"}
    c = sub.add_parser("cases", help="list the cases you can play")
    c.add_argument("--set", **sets)
    p = sub.add_parser("play", help="play one case")
    p.add_argument("case_id")
    p.add_argument("--agent", default="naive", choices=["naive", "llm"])
    p.add_argument("--data", **data)
    a = sub.add_parser("run", help="play every case of a set in parallel")
    a.add_argument("--set", **sets)
    a.add_argument("--agent", default="naive", choices=["naive", "llm"])
    a.add_argument("--data", **data)
    a.add_argument("--parallel", type=int, default=8, help="cases at once (at most 10)")
    a.add_argument("--waves", type=int, default=5, help="final: stop after this many waves have closed")
    d = sub.add_parser("data", help="download and unpack the data (package, Sunday release once public)")
    d.add_argument("--out", default="data", help="folder to unpack into")
    sub.add_parser("me", help="your team: practice quota used and left, best score per case")
    b = sub.add_parser("board", help="show the leaderboard")
    b.add_argument("--set", **sets)
    m = sub.add_parser("mcp", help="run the read-only MCP server over the data (stdio)")
    m.add_argument("--data", **data)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO if args.verbose else logging.WARNING,
        format="%(asctime)s %(message)s",
        datefmt="%H:%M:%S",
    )

    if args.cmd == "mcp":
        from .mcp_server import main as serve

        return serve(args.data)
    client = ArenaClient()
    if args.cmd == "register":
        out = client.register(args.team_name, args.event_code)
        print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
        print("\nA simulator key: put it into .env as ARENA_API_KEY=... while you point ARENA_URL at arena-sim.")
    elif args.cmd == "cases":
        cases = client.cases(args.set)
        playable = {c["case_id"] for c in hosted(cases)}
        for case in cases:
            mark = "" if case["case_id"] in playable else "  (not hosted: data only)"
            print(case["case_id"], case.get("type", ""), case.get("title", "") + mark, sep="  ")
    elif args.cmd == "me":
        try:
            print(json.dumps(client.me(), indent=2))
        except ArenaError as e:
            print(f"no team view on this arena ({e})" if e.status == 404 else e)
    elif args.cmd == "board":
        print(json.dumps(client.leaderboard(args.set), indent=2))
    elif args.cmd == "data":
        for name, info in client.downloads().items():
            if info.get("url"):
                zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(client.download(name))).extractall(args.out)
                print(f"{name}: {Path(args.out) / name}")
            else:
                print(f"{name}: public from {info.get('at')}")
    elif args.cmd == "play":
        table = RemoteTable(client)
        try:
            result = play(table, args.case_id, agent_factory(args.agent, args.data)())
        except ArenaError as e:  # e.g. not hosted, the quota, a paused key: the arena says why
            raise SystemExit(str(e)) from None
        print(json.dumps(summary(result), indent=2))
        replay = client.session(table.session_id).get("replay_url")
        if replay:  # the supplier's reasons, move by move: read it, improve, play again
            print(f"replay: {os.environ['ARENA_URL'].rstrip('/')}{replay}")
    elif args.set == "final":  # waits for each wave and plays its cases within the cap
        out = play_waves(client, agent_factory(args.agent, args.data), args.waves, min(args.parallel, 10))
    else:
        ids = [case["case_id"] for case in hosted(client.cases(args.set))]
        out = play_all(
            lambda: RemoteTable(client),
            ids,
            agent_factory(args.agent, args.data),
            min(args.parallel, 10),
        )
    if args.cmd == "run":
        for case_id, result in out.items():
            print(case_id, result if isinstance(result, Exception) else summary(result))
        scores = {c: r.get("score") for c, r in out.items() if isinstance(r, dict)}
        if args.set == "final" and scores:  # points so far: each wave 0-100, their sum, as the board counts
            waves = {}
            for case in client.cases("final"):  # your own case list: which wave each case was in
                waves.setdefault(case["wave"], []).append(scores.get(case["case_id"]) or 0)
            points = {n: round(100 * statistics.mean(v), 1) for n, v in sorted(waves.items())}
            print(f"waves: {points}  points so far: {round(sum(points.values()), 1)} (the board is the record)")
        elif scores and all(v is not None for v in scores.values()):
            print(f"mean score: {100 * statistics.mean(scores.values()):.1f}")
    if args.cmd in ("play", "run") and client.practice_remaining is not None:
        print(f"practice sessions left today: {client.practice_remaining}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"""Thin HTTP client for the arena API. Every method returns the JSON the server sends."""

import os
import threading
import time
import uuid

import httpx

# Venue Wi-Fi drops. Retrying with the same move id makes the server return the reply it already
# gave instead of playing the move twice, so retries are safe even mid-negotiation.
MOVE_ID_HEADER = "X-Move-Id"
RETRY_STATUS = {429, 500, 502, 503, 504}
CALLS_PER_SECOND = 9  # the arena allows 10 per key; stay just below, across all threads
# A supplier's reply can take up to about a minute (its time does not count against your 60 s),
# and a call may wait for another call on the same session first: wait long enough for both.
TIMEOUT_S = 180.0
# Practice has a daily quota per team: every practice session start carries what is left in this
# header, and GET /v1/me tells where the team stands.
REMAINING_HEADER = "X-Practice-Remaining"
ME_PATH = "/me"
# A 429 with a short Retry-After is the per-second rate limit: wait and retry. Any other 429 (the
# practice quota, too many open sessions) does not go away by retrying.
MAX_RETRY_AFTER_S = 5


class ArenaError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status: int, detail):
        super().__init__(f"HTTP {status}: {detail}")
        self.status, self.detail = status, detail


class ArenaClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url=None,
        api_key=None,
        *,
        retries=3,
        transport=None,
        timeout=TIMEOUT_S,
        rate=CALLS_PER_SECOND,
    ):
        base_url = (base_url or os.environ.get("ARENA_URL", "")).rstrip("/")
        if not base_url:
            raise ValueError("set ARENA_URL (e.g. https://…) or pass base_url")
        key = api_key or os.environ.get("ARENA_API_KEY")
        headers = {"X-API-Key": key} if key else {}
        self.retries, self.rate, self._lock, self._next = retries, rate, threading.Lock(), 0.0
        self.practice_remaining = None  # from the last practice reply that said so
        self.http = httpx.Client(base_url=f"{base_url}/v1", headers=headers, timeout=timeout, transport=transport)

    def _pace(self):
        with self._lock:
            now = time.monotonic()
            wait, self._next = self._next - now, max(now, self._next) + 1 / self.rate
        if wait > 0:
            time.sleep(wait)

    def _call(self, method, path, body=None, params=None, raw=False):
        headers = {MOVE_ID_HEADER: uuid.uuid4().hex} if method == "POST" else {}
        for attempt in range(self.retries + 1):
            self._pace()
            try:
                r = self.http.request(method, path, json=body, params=params, headers=headers)
            except httpx.TransportError:
                if attempt == self.retries:
                    raise
                wait = None
            else:
                wait = r.headers.get("Retry-After", "")
                short = wait.isdigit() and int(wait) <= MAX_RETRY_AFTER_S
                if r.status_code not in RETRY_STATUS or attempt == self.retries or (r.status_code == 429 and not short):
                    break
            time.sleep(float(wait) if wait and wait.isdigit() else 0.5 * 2**attempt)
        if (left := r.headers.get(REMAINING_HEADER, "")).isdigit():
            self.practice_remaining = int(left)
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            try:
                detail = r.json().get("detail", r.text)
            except (ValueError, AttributeError):
                detail = r.text
            raise ArenaError(r.status_code, detail)
        return r.content if raw else r.json()

    def register(self, team_name, event_code):
        """arena-sim only: the simulator hands out its own keys. On the arena, the organisers
        give each team its key."""
        return self._call("POST", "/register", {"team_name": team_name, "event_code": event_code})

    def me(self):
        """Your team: practice sessions used and left, when the quota resets, best score per case."""
        return self._call("GET", ME_PATH)

    def cases(self, set_="practice"):
        return self._call("GET", "/cases", params={"set": set_})

    def open_session(self, case_id):
        return self._call("POST", "/sessions", {"case_id": case_id})

    def send_message(self, session_id, supplier_id, message):
        """Your e-mail to one supplier; returns its reply (or the result, if `action` closes)."""
        path = f"/sessions/{session_id}/threads/{supplier_id}/messages"
        return self._call("POST", path, {"message": message})

    def thread(self, session_id, supplier_id):
        return self._call("GET", f"/sessions/{session_id}/threads/{supplier_id}")

    def attachment(self, session_id, attachment_id):
        """The bytes of a document a supplier attached."""
        return self._call("GET", f"/sessions/{session_id}/attachments/{attachment_id}", raw=True)

    def backoffice(self, session_id):
        return self._call("GET", f"/sessions/{session_id}/backoffice")

    def move(self, session_id, supplier_id, move):
        body = {"supplier_id": supplier_id, "move": move}
        return self._call("POST", f"/sessions/{session_id}/moves", body)

    def accept(self, session_id, offer_id):
        return self._call("POST", f"/sessions/{session_id}/accept", {"offer_id": offer_id})

    def walk_away(self, session_id):
        return self._call("POST", f"/sessions/{session_id}/walk_away")

    def session(self, session_id):
        return self._call("GET", f"/sessions/{session_id}")

    def sessions(self, set_="practice"):
        return self._call("GET", "/sessions", params={"set": set_})

    def leaderboard(self, set_="practice"):
        return self._call("GET", "/leaderboard", params={"set": set_})

    def downloads(self):
        """The data you can download: the package, and the Sunday release once it is public."""
        return self._call("GET", "/data")

    def download(self, name):
        """A data download (zip bytes), e.g. "package" or "release-sunday"."""
        return self._call("GET", f"/data/{name}.zip", raw=True)
"""Read-only access to the data package: SQL, lookup by citable ID, documents, practice cases -
plus the Sunday release (new news, letters and a memo) once you have downloaded it."""

import csv
import json
import os
import sqlite3
from functools import cached_property
from pathlib import Path

MAX_ROWS = 200
RELEASE = "release-sunday"


class DataPackage:
    def __init__(self, root, release=None):
        """`root`: the unpacked package. `release`: the unpacked Sunday release (default: a
        `release-sunday` folder inside or next to the package, or ARENA_RELEASE), if present."""
        self.root = Path(root).expanduser().resolve()
        # facts.json holds every citable fact with the fields the arena checks claims against.
        own = self.root / "facts.json"
        facts = [own] if own.is_file() else [p for p in sorted(self.root.rglob("facts.json")) if RELEASE not in p.parts]
        self.facts = json.loads(facts[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if facts else {}
        release = release or os.environ.get("ARENA_RELEASE")
        candidates = [Path(release).expanduser()] if release else [self.root / RELEASE, self.root.parent / RELEASE]
        self.release = next((p.resolve() for p in candidates if (p / "facts.json").is_file()), None)
        if self.release:  # new IDs only: nothing in the package changes
            self.facts |= json.loads((self.release / "facts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        dbs = sorted(self.root.rglob("*.sqlite")) + sorted(self.root.rglob("*.db"))
        if not dbs and not facts:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"no facts.json or .sqlite under {self.root}")
        self.db = None
        if dbs:
            self.db = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{dbs[0]}?mode=ro", uri=True, check_same_thread=False)
            self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            self.db.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")

    def tables(self):
        """{table: {"columns": [...], "rows": n}}"""
        if self.db is None:
            return {}
        names = [r[0] for r in self.db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name")]
        return {
            t: {
                "columns": [f"{c[1]} {c[2]}".strip() for c in self.db.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info("{t}")')],
                "rows": self.db.execute(f'SELECT count(*) FROM "{t}"').fetchone()[0],
            }
            for t in names
        }

    def query(self, sql, params=(), limit=MAX_ROWS):
        if self.db is None:
            raise ValueError("this package has no SQLite file")
        if sql.lstrip().split(None, 1)[0].lower() not in {"select", "with"}:
            raise ValueError("read-only: SELECT or WITH statements only")
        cur = self.db.execute(sql, params)
        return [dict(r) for r in cur.fetchmany(limit)]

    @cached_property
    def _ids(self):
        # A table's citable ID sits in its `id` column, else in its first column.
        index = {}
        for t, meta in self.tables().items():
            cols = [c.split()[0] for c in meta["columns"]]
            key = "id" if "id" in cols else cols[0]
            for row in self.db.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{t}"'):
                value = row[key]
                if isinstance(value, str) and ":" in value:
                    index[value] = {"table": t, **dict(row)}
        for path in sorted(self.release.glob("data/*.csv")) if self.release else []:  # not in the SQLite
            with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
                for row in csv.DictReader(f):
                    index[row["id"]] = {"table": path.stem, **row, "root": str(self.release)}
        return index

    def lookup(self, ref):
        """The fact behind a citable ID (from facts.json, else its table row), or None."""
        return self.facts.get(ref) or self._ids.get(ref)

    def ids(self, prefix):
        """All citable IDs starting with `prefix`, sorted, e.g. ids("idx:GP19-245113@")."""
        return sorted(i for i in self.facts.keys() | self._ids.keys() if i.startswith(prefix))

    def document(self, ref):

529	        if post:

537	    def act(request, req, fn):
538	        """One POST: authenticated, rate-limited, answered from the store when retried."""
539	        with sim.lock:
540	            team, move_id = team_of(request, post=True), request.headers.get("x-move-id")
541	            digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([request.url.path, req], sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
542	            if move_id and (team, move_id) in sim.replies:

"""arena-sim: a minimal arena that speaks the public API exactly - to learn the contract.

Same paths, fields, statuses, errors and limits as the hosted arena; quote PDFs and cost-breakdown
XLSX files in the same format. Its supplier, though, is one plain script for every case and NOT
how the arena's suppliers behave: it opens 10 % above your current price, concedes a fixed 2 % of
its opening per message with a term sheet down to 90 %, agrees when you meet its price, sends a
final offer from round 5 and walks away if you push after that. It checks cited data only for
whether the ID exists. The simulator teaches the contract; the real suppliers think for themselves.

    arena-sim serve [--port 8000] [--data <data package>] [--event-code sim] [--no-clock]

--no-clock switches the 60-second rule off (threads wait forever) to try the API by hand.
"""

import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import html
import io
import itertools
import json
import re
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

from .cost import closing_terms, cost_breakdown, must_haves_ok, score, total_cost
from .docs import LABELS

CASES = Path(__file__).parent / "sim_cases"
MOVE_S, MAX_OPEN, MAX_CALLS, MAX_BODY = 60, 10, 10, 64_000
PRACTICE_LIMIT, DAY_S, REMAINING = 200, 86_400, "X-Practice-Remaining"  # the arena's practice quota
OPEN_UP, STEP, FLOOR, FINAL_ROUND = 0.10, 0.02, 0.90, 5
ID_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:idx|quote|offer|sc|qn|po|cost|fc|news|doc|ctr):[\w.:@#/-]*\w")
LATE = "late: more than 60 s after the supplier's last move, so it counted as a timeout"
NAMES = {field: label for label, field in LABELS.items()}
SIGNALS = {"reply_delay_days": 1, "validity_days": 30}


def _fmt(v):
    return "none" if v is None else f"{v:.2f}" if isinstance(v, float) else str(v)


def pdf(title, sections):
    """A one-page PDF of text lines, labelled like the arena's quotes."""
    lines = [title]
    for head, terms in sections:
        lines += [head, *(f"{NAMES.get(k, k)} {_fmt(v)}" for k, v in terms.items())]
    esc = [x.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)") for x in lines]
    text = "".join(f"BT /F1 10 Tf 50 {800 - 14 * i} Td ({t}) Tj ET\n" for i, t in enumerate(esc))
    page = "/MediaBox [0 0 595 842] /Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R"
    objs = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R {page} >>",
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        f"<< /Length {len(text)} >>\nstream\n{text}endstream",
    ]
    out, offsets = "%PDF-1.4\n", []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objs, 1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n{obj}\nendobj\n"
    xref = f"xref\n0 {len(objs) + 1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    xref += "".join(f"{o:010d} 00000 n \n" for o in offsets)
    tail = f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objs) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{len(out)}\n%%EOF\n"
    return (out + xref + tail).encode("latin-1", "replace")


def xlsx(price):
    from openpyxl import Workbook

    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Cost breakdown"
    ws.append(["Element", "EUR per unit", "Share of price"])
    for i, (name, share) in enumerate(
        [("Material", 0.5), ("Conversion", 0.3), ("Overhead", 0.15), ("Margin", 0.05)], 2
    ):
        ws.append([name, round(price * share, 2), f"=B{i}/B6"])
    ws.append(["Unit price", "=SUM(B2:B5)", "=SUM(C2:C5)"])
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    wb.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()


def structured(msg, round_):
    """A supplier e-mail in the structured shape of the /moves path."""
    sheet = (msg["term_sheets"] or [{}])[0]
    return {
        "offer_id": sheet.get("term_sheet_id"),
        "round": round_,
        "status": msg["status"],
        "terms": sheet.get("terms", {}),
        "missing_fields": msg["missing_fields"],
        "claims": [],
        "claim_results": msg["claim_results"],
        "signals": SIGNALS,
        "text": msg["body"],
    }


class Fail(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status, detail, headers=None):
        self.status, self.detail, self.headers = status, detail, headers


class Sim:
    """The arena's state and its one scripted supplier. One lock serialises every call."""

    def __init__(self, cases, facts=None, event_code="sim", clock=time.time, no_clock=False):
        self.cases, self.facts, self.code, self.clock = cases, facts or {}, event_code, clock
        self.no_clock = no_clock  # no 60-second rule: to try the API by hand
        self.teams, self.sessions, self.replies, self.calls = {}, {}, {}, {}
        self.ids, self.lock = itertools.count(1), threading.Lock()

    # -- the scripted supplier -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _mail(self, s, th, status, stated, text, files=()):
        th["n"] += 1
        th.update(status=status, stated=stated, offer_id=f"offer:{th['key']}-{th['round']}")
        s["offers"][th["offer_id"]] = stated
        sheets = [] if status == "walked_away" else [{"term_sheet_id": th["offer_id"], "terms": stated}]
        msg = {
            "thread_id": f"thread:{s['case']['case_id'][5:]}:{th['key']}",
            "message_id": f"msg:{th['key']}-{th['round']}-{th['n']}",
            "in_reply_to": None,
            "from": f"sales@{th['key']}",
            "subject": f"Re: {s['case']['title']}",
            "body": f"Simulated supplier. {text}",
            "refs": [],
            "action": None,
            "term_sheets": sheets,
            "status": status,
            "signals": SIGNALS,
            "claim_results": [],
            "missing_fields": sorted(set(s["case"]["negotiable"]) - set(stated)),
            "attachments": [],
        }
        for kind in files:
            att = f"att:{th['key']}-{th['round']}-{kind.split('.')[0]}"
            s["files"][att] = (kind, dict(stated), dict(th["standard"]))
            msg["attachments"].append(
                {"attachment_id": att, "name": kind, "type": kind[-4:].strip("."), "content_b64": None}
            )
        th["messages"].append(msg)
        return msg

    def _answer(self, s, th, msg, sheets):
        results = []
        for i, ref in enumerate(list(dict.fromkeys(msg.get("refs", []) + ID_RE.findall(msg.get("body", ""))))[:3]):
            known = ref in self.facts or ref in s["case"].get("facts", {}) or ref in s["offers"]
            # a rival's quote may be cited to every bidder: it counts once per supplier, the rest once per case
            seen = (th["key"], ref) if ref.startswith(("quote:", "offer:")) else ref
            result = "contradicted" if not known else "duplicate" if seen in s["used"] else "verified"
            results.append({"index": i, "result": result})
            if known:
                s["used"].add(seen)
        files = ["cost-breakdown.xlsx"] if "breakdown" in msg.get("body", "").lower() else []
        price = round(max(th["opening"] * FLOOR, th["stated"]["unit_price"] - th["opening"] * STEP), 2)
        best = max(sheets, key=lambda t: t["unit_price"]) if sheets else None
        if best is None:
            reply = self._mail(s, th, th["status"], th["stated"], "We keep our offer.", files)
        elif best["unit_price"] >= price:
            reply = self._mail(s, th, "agreed", best, "We agree.", [*files, "quote.pdf"])
        elif th["status"] == "final_offer":
            th["closed"] = "walked_away"
            reply = self._mail(s, th, "walked_away", th["stated"], "We end here.")
        elif th["round"] >= FINAL_ROUND:
            reply = self._mail(s, th, "final_offer", {"unit_price": price}, "Final offer.", [*files, "quote.pdf"])
        else:
            reply = self._mail(s, th, "open", {"unit_price": price}, "Our counter-offer.", files)
        reply["claim_results"] = results
        s["trace"].append(
            {
                "round": th["round"],
                "actor": f"sup:{th['key']}",
                "move": structured(reply, th["round"]),
                "reasons": ["A fixed script: it concedes the same step per term sheet, down to its floor."],
            }  # the practice shape: the move and the supplier's reasons in words
        )
        return reply

    def _check(self, case, terms, th):
        if set(terms) != set(case["negotiable"]) or not (terms.get("unit_price") or 0) > 0:
            raise Fail(422, f"a term sheet carries exactly the negotiable fields {case['negotiable']}")
        for f, v in terms.items():
            options = case["term_options"].get(f)
            if f != "unit_price" and options and v not in options and v != th["standard"].get(f):
                raise Fail(422, f"{f}={v!r} is not one of {options}")
        return terms

    # -- sessions ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def open(self, team, case_id):
        case = self.cases.get(case_id)
        if case is None:
            raise Fail(404, "no such case")
        if sum(s["status"] == "open" for s in self._mine(team)) >= MAX_OPEN:
            raise Fail(429, f"at most {MAX_OPEN} open sessions per key")
        if (p := self.practice(team))["left"] == 0:  # no Retry-After: retrying does not help
            raise Fail(429, f"practice limit: {PRACTICE_LIMIT} sessions per team in 24 hours; resets_at "
                       f"{p['resets_at']}", {REMAINING: "0"})  # fmt: skip
        sid, current = f"sim{next(self.ids)}", case["buyer"].get("current_unit_price")
        s = {
            "id": sid,
            "team": team,
            "case": case,
            "status": "open",
            "end_reason": None,
            "threads": {},
            "files": {},
            "offers": {},
            "used": set(),
            "result": None,
            "trace": [],
            "moves": [],
            "created_at": self.clock(),
            "late": set(),
        }
        for i, sup in enumerate(case["suppliers"]):
            opening = round((current or case["buyer"]["fallback_unit_price"]) * (1 + OPEN_UP + 0.02 * i), 2)
            standard = {f: (case["term_options"].get(f) or [None])[0] for f in case["negotiable"][1:]}
            th = s["threads"][sup] = {
                "key": sup.split(":", 1)[1],
                "round": 0,
                "n": 0,
                "timeouts": 0,
                "closed": None,
                "last_at": self.clock(),
                "messages": [],
                "late": [],
                "standard": standard,
                "opening": opening,
            }
            self._mail(s, th, "open", {"unit_price": opening}, "Our quote is attached.", ["quote.pdf"])
        self.sessions[sid] = s
        return {
            "session_id": sid,
            "case": case,
            "opening": {k: structured(th["messages"][0], 0) for k, th in s["threads"].items()},
            "threads": {k: list(th["messages"]) for k, th in s["threads"].items()},
        }

    def _mine(self, team):
        return [s for s in self.sessions.values() if s["team"] == team]

    def practice(self, team):
        """The team's practice quota in the rolling 24 hours, as GET /v1/me shows it."""
        day = sorted(s["created_at"] for s in self._mine(team) if s["created_at"] > self.clock() - DAY_S)
        frees = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(day[0] + DAY_S, datetime.UTC).isoformat() if day else None
        return {
            "used": len(day),
            "left": max(0, PRACTICE_LIMIT - len(day)),
            "limit": PRACTICE_LIMIT,
            "resets_at": frees,
        }

    def session(self, team, sid):
        s = self.sessions.get(sid)
        if s is None or s["team"] != team:
            raise Fail(404, "no such session")
        s["late"] = self._tick(s)
        return s

    def _tick(self, s):
        """The 60-second rule: a supplier left waiting counts a timeout - its offer stands; the
        third in a row (or one after the last round) ends the thread. Returns who just got one."""
        late = set()
        if self.no_clock:
            return late
        for sup, th in s["threads"].items():
            while s["status"] == "open" and not th["closed"] and self.clock() > th["last_at"] + MOVE_S:
                th["last_at"] += MOVE_S
                th["round"] += 1
                th["timeouts"] += 1
                th["late"].append({"offer_id": th["offer_id"], "status": th["status"], "terms": th["stated"]})
                if th["timeouts"] >= 3 or th["round"] >= s["case"]["round_limit"]:
                    th["closed"] = "timeout"
                late.add(sup)
        self._settle(s, "timeout")
        return late

    def _settle(self, s, reason):
        if s["status"] == "open" and all(th["closed"] for th in s["threads"].values()):
            self._end(s, reason, None)

    def _end(self, s, reason, sup):
        case, ths = s["case"], s["threads"]
        c_open = min(total_cost(case, {"unit_price": th["opening"]}, th["standard"]) for th in ths.values())
        # the best this script would ever accept: its floor price, any allowed values of the other terms
        options = [case["term_options"].get(f) or [None] for f in case["negotiable"][1:]]
        c_best = min(
            total_cost(
                case,
                {
                    **dict(zip(case["negotiable"][1:], combo, strict=True)),
                    "unit_price": round(th["opening"] * FLOOR, 2),
                },
            )
            for th in ths.values()
            for combo in itertools.product(*options)
        )
        alt = case["buyer"].get("alternative") or {}
        c_alt = total_cost(case, alt["terms"]) if alt.get("terms", {}).get("unit_price") else None
        r = {
            "ended": True,
            "deal": False,
            "supplier_id": None,
            "offer_id": None,
            "terms": None,
            "c_open": c_open,
            "c_deal": None,
            "c_alt": c_alt,
            "c_best": c_best,
            "score": score(c_open, c_alt, c_best) if c_alt else 0.0,
            "must_haves_ok": None,
            "cost_breakdown": None,
            "trace": [],
        }
        if sup:
            t = closing_terms(case, ths[sup]["stated"], ths[sup]["standard"])
            r.update(
                deal=True,
                supplier_id=sup,
                offer_id=ths[sup]["offer_id"],
                terms=t,
                c_deal=total_cost(case, t),
                must_haves_ok=must_haves_ok(case, t),
                cost_breakdown=cost_breakdown(case, t),
            )
            r["score"] = score(c_open, r["c_deal"], c_best) if r["must_haves_ok"] else 0.0
        s.update(status="ended", end_reason=reason, result=r)
        for th in ths.values():
            th["closed"] = th["closed"] or reason

    def message(self, team, sid, sup, msg):
        s = self.session(team, sid)
        if s["status"] != "open":
            raise Fail(409, f"the session has ended: {s['end_reason']}")
        if sup not in s["threads"]:
            raise Fail(422, f"{sup} is not a supplier in this case")
        th, action = s["threads"][sup], msg.get("action") or {}
        if action.get("type") == "walk_away":
            self._end(s, "walked_away", None)
            note = {"body": "Simulated supplier. Understood - no deal.", "term_sheets": [], "attachments": []}
            return {**th["messages"][-1], **note, "result": _public(s["result"])}
        if sup in s["late"]:
            raise Fail(409, f"{LATE}; GET the thread for the supplier's answer")
        if th["closed"]:
            raise Fail(409, f"the thread with {sup} has ended: {th['closed']}")
        if action.get("type") == "accept":
            sheet = action.get("term_sheet_id")
            owner = next((k for k, t in s["threads"].items() if t["offer_id"] == sheet and not t["closed"]), None)
            if owner is None:
                raise Fail(422, "not a standing offer in this session")
            reply = self._mail(
                s,
                s["threads"][owner],
                "agreed",
                s["threads"][owner]["stated"],
                "Thank you for your order.",
                ["order-confirmation.pdf"],
            )
            self._end(s, "accepted", owner)
            return {**reply, "result": _public(s["result"])}
        if action:
            raise Fail(422, "action is {'type': 'accept', 'term_sheet_id': ...} or 'walk_away'")
        sheets = [self._check(s["case"], ts.get("terms", {}), th) for ts in msg.get("term_sheets") or []]
        if len(sheets) > 3 or len(msg.get("body", "")) > 8000 or len(msg.get("refs", [])) > 20:
            raise Fail(422, "at most 3 term sheets, 8,000 characters and 20 refs")
        if th["round"] >= s["case"]["round_limit"]:
            raise Fail(409, "round limit reached: accept the standing offer or walk away")
        th.update(round=th["round"] + 1, timeouts=0, last_at=self.clock())
        th["messages"].append({**msg, "from": "buyer"})
        reply = self._answer(s, th, msg, sheets)
        self._settle(s, "no_deal")
        return {**reply, "result": _public(s["result"])} if s["result"] else reply

    def attachment(self, team, sid, att):
        s = self.session(team, sid)
        if att not in s["files"]:
            raise Fail(404, "no such attachment in this session")
        kind, stated, standard = s["files"][att]
        if kind.endswith(".xlsx"):
            return xlsx(stated["unit_price"]), "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
        fixed = s["case"].get("fixed_terms", {})
        if kind.startswith("order"):
            return pdf("Order confirmation", [("Agreed terms", {**fixed, **standard, **stated})]), "application/pdf"
        rest = {k: v for k, v in standard.items() if k not in stated}
        sections = [
            ("Offered terms", stated),
            ("Our standard terms (apply to everything not stated above)", rest),
            ("Terms fixed by your enquiry", fixed),
        ]
        return pdf("Quote - simulated supplier", sections), "application/pdf"

    def state(self, team, sid):
        s, now = self.session(team, sid), self.clock()
        threads = {
            k: {
                "offer_id": t["offer_id"],
                "status": t["status"],
                "closed": t["closed"],
                "offers": t["round"] - t["timeouts"],
                "seconds_left": None
                if t["closed"] or self.no_clock
                else max(0.0, round(t["last_at"] + MOVE_S - now, 1)),
            }
            for k, t in s["threads"].items()
        }
        out = {
            "session_id": sid,
            "case_id": s["case"]["case_id"],
            "set": "practice",
            "status": s["status"],
            "end_reason": s["end_reason"],
            "threads": threads,
            "rounds": sum(t["round"] for t in s["threads"].values()),
            "opening": {k: structured(t["messages"][0], 0) for k, t in s["threads"].items()},
            "moves": s["moves"],
        }
        if s["result"]:
            out.update(result={**s["result"], "trace": s["trace"]}, replay_url=f"/replay/{sid}")
        return out

    def thread(self, team, sid, sup):
        th = self.session(team, sid)["threads"].get(sup)
        if th is None:
            raise Fail(404, f"{sup} is not a supplier in this case")
        return {
            "supplier_id": sup,
            "offer_id": th["offer_id"],
            "status": th["status"],
            "closed": th["closed"],
            "messages": th["messages"],
            "timeouts": th["late"],
        }

    def board(self):
        rows = []
        for team, name in self.teams.items():
            best, ended = {}, [s for s in self._mine(team) if s["result"]]
            for s in ended:
                best[s["case"]["case_id"]] = max(best.get(s["case"]["case_id"], 0), s["result"]["score"])
            total = round(100 * sum(best.values()) / len(self.cases), 1)
            deals, rounds = (
                sum(s["result"]["deal"] for s in ended),
                sum(self.state(team, s["id"])["rounds"] for s in ended),
            )
            rows.append({"team_name": name, "played": len(best), "total": total, "deals": deals, "rounds": rounds})
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r["total"])
        teams = [{**r, "rank": i} for i, r in enumerate(rows, 1)]
        return {"set": "practice", "cases": len(self.cases), "window": None, "teams": teams}


def _public(result):
    return {k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "trace"}

color:#1d1d1f;background:#fff}h1{font-size:20px}h2{font-size:17px;margin-top:28px}
table{border-collapse:collapse;margin:6px 0}caption{text-align:left}
td,th{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:3px 8px;text-align:left}
.mail{border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;margin:10px 0}.buyer{background:#eef4ff}

.tag{color:#aaa}td,th,.mail{border-color:#444}}"""


def replay_html(replay):
    """The replay as a page for a browser: the result on top, then each thread's e-mails in order."""
    e, r = html.escape, replay["result"]

    def sheet(terms, caption=""):
        cap = f"<caption class='tag'>{e(caption)}</caption>" if caption else ""
        rows = "".join(f"<tr><td>{e(NAMES.get(k, k))}</td><td>{e(_fmt(v))}</td></tr>" for k, v in terms.items())
        return f"<table>{cap}{rows}</table>"

    money = {k: "-" if r[k] is None else f"{r[k]:,.2f}" for k in ("c_open", "c_deal", "c_best")}
    head = f"Deal with {r['supplier_id']}" if r["deal"] else "No deal"
    out = [
        f"<h1>Replay {e(replay['session_id'])} - {e(replay['case_id'])}</h1><h2>{e(head)}</h2><table>",
        *(f"<tr><th>{k}</th><td>{v}</td></tr>" for k, v in money.items()),
        f"<tr><th>score</th><td>{r['score']:.3f}</td></tr></table>",
        sheet(r["terms"], f"agreed terms ({r['offer_id']})") if r["deal"] else "",
    ]
    for sup, messages in replay["threads"].items():
        out.append(f"<h2>Thread with {e(sup)}</h2>")
        for m in messages:
            buyer = m.get("from") == "buyer"
            status = "" if buyer else f" <span class='tag'>{e(str(m.get('status')))}</span>"
            out.append(f"<div class='mail {'buyer' if buyer else 'supplier'}'>")
            out.append(f"<div><span class='who'>{e(str(m.get('from')))}</span>{status}</div>")
            out.append(f"<div class='tag'>{e(str(m.get('subject', '')))}</div>")
            out.append(f"<div class='body'>{e(str(m.get('body', '')))}</div>")
            for t in m.get("term_sheets") or []:
                out.append(sheet(t.get("terms", {}), t.get("term_sheet_id") or "term sheet"))
            if m.get("action"):
                out.append(f"<div class='tag'>action: {e(json.dumps(m['action']))}</div>")
            if m.get("attachments"):
                out.append(f"<div class='tag'>attached: {e(', '.join(a['name'] for a in m['attachments']))}</div>")
            out.append("</div>")
    title = f"Replay {replay['session_id']}"
    return (
        f"<!doctype html><html lang='en'><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>{e(title)}</title>"
        f"<meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1'><style>{PAGE_CSS}</style></head>"
        f"<body>{''.join(out)}</body></html>"
    )


def create_app(sim):
    from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
    from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, Response

    app = FastAPI(title="arena-sim")

    @app.middleware("http")
    async def size_limit(request: Request, call_next):
        if int(request.headers.get("content-length") or 0) > MAX_BODY:
            return JSONResponse({"detail": "request body too large"}, 413)
        return await call_next(request)

    @app.exception_handler(Fail)
    async def failed(_, e: Fail):
        return JSONResponse({"detail": e.detail}, e.status, headers=e.headers)

    def team_of(request, post=False):
        key = request.headers.get("x-api-key", "")
        if key not in sim.teams:
            raise Fail(401, "missing or unknown X-API-Key")
        if post:
            now, calls = time.monotonic(), sim.calls.setdefault(key, [])
            calls[:] = [t for t in calls if now - t < 1]
            if len(calls) >= MAX_CALLS:
                raise Fail(429, f"more than {MAX_CALLS} calls per second", {"Retry-After": "1"})  # as the arena
            calls.append(now)
        return key

    def act(request, req, fn):
        """One POST: authenticated, rate-limited, answered from the store when retried."""
        with sim.lock:
            team, move_id = team_of(request, post=True), request.headers.get("x-move-id")
            digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([request.url.path, req], sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
            if move_id and (team, move_id) in sim.replies:
                seen, reply = sim.replies[(team, move_id)]
                if seen != digest:
                    raise Fail(422, "X-Move-Id was already used for a different request")
                return reply
            reply = fn(team)
            if move_id:
                sim.replies[(team, move_id)] = (digest, reply)
            return reply

    def read(request, fn):
        with sim.lock:
            return fn(team_of(request))

    @app.get("/health")
    def health():
        return {"ok": True}

    @app.post("/v1/register")
    def register(body: dict):
        with sim.lock:
            if body.get("event_code") != sim.code:
                raise Fail(403, "wrong event code")
            if body.get("team_name") in sim.teams.values():
                raise Fail(409, "team name already registered")
            key = hashlib.sha256(f"{body.get('team_name')}{time.time()}".encode()).hexdigest()
            sim.teams[key] = body.get("team_name")
            return {"team_id": f"team-{key[:8]}", "api_key": key}

    @app.get("/v1/cases")
    def cases(request: Request, set: str = "practice"):
        if set == "final":
            raise Fail(403, "the final window is not open")
        return read(request, lambda t: [{**c, "hosted": True} for c in sim.cases.values()])

    @app.post("/v1/sessions")
    def create(request: Request, body: dict, response: Response):
        reply = act(request, body, lambda t: sim.open(t, body.get("case_id")))
        response.headers[REMAINING] = str(read(request, sim.practice)["left"])
        return reply

    @app.get("/v1/me")
    def me(request: Request):
        def fn(t):
            best = {}
            for x in sim._mine(t):
                if x["result"]:
                    best[x["case"]["case_id"]] = max(best.get(x["case"]["case_id"], 0), x["result"]["score"])
            return {"team_name": sim.teams[t], "status": "active", "practice": sim.practice(t), "best": best}

        return read(request, fn)

    @app.get("/v1/sessions")
    def sessions(request: Request, set: str = "practice"):
        keep = ("case_id", "status", "end_reason", "rounds")
        return read(
            request,
            lambda t: [
                {
                    **{k: sim.state(t, s["id"])[k] for k in keep},
                    "session_id": s["id"],
                    **{k: (s["result"] or {}).get(k) for k in ("deal", "score")},
                    "created_at": s["created_at"],
                }
                for s in sim._mine(t)
            ],
        )

    @app.get("/v1/sessions/{sid}")
    def state(request: Request, sid: str):
        return read(request, lambda t: sim.state(t, sid))

    @app.post("/v1/sessions/{sid}/threads/{sup}/messages")
    def message(request: Request, sid: str, sup: str, body: dict):
        return act(request, body, lambda t: sim.message(t, sid, sup, body.get("message") or {}))

    @app.get("/v1/sessions/{sid}/threads/{sup}")
    def thread(request: Request, sid: str, sup: str):
        return read(request, lambda t: sim.thread(t, sid, sup))

    @app.get("/v1/sessions/{sid}/attachments/{att}")
    def attachment(request: Request, sid: str, att: str):
        data, media = read(request, lambda t: sim.attachment(t, sid, att))
        return Response(data, media_type=media)

    @app.get("/v1/sessions/{sid}/backoffice")
    def backoffice(request: Request, sid: str):
        def fn(t):
            if sim.state(t, sid)["status"] != "ended":
                raise Fail(403, "the back office shows after the case ends")
            return [{"from": "sales", "to": "team", "text": "The simulator has no back office."}]

        return read(request, fn)

    @app.post("/v1/sessions/{sid}/moves")
    def move(request: Request, sid: str, body: dict):
        def fn(t):  # the structured path: an offer is an e-mail with one term sheet
            m = body.get("move") or {}
            if m.get("type") != "offer":
                raise Fail(422, "a move has type 'offer'; use /accept or /walk_away to close")
            refs = [r for c in m.get("claims", []) for r in c.get("refs", [])]
            msg = {"body": m.get("text", ""), "refs": refs, "term_sheets": [{"terms": m.get("terms", {})}]}
            reply = sim.message(t, sid, body.get("supplier_id", ""), msg)
            out = structured(reply, sim.sessions[sid]["threads"][body["supplier_id"]]["round"])
            sim.sessions[sid]["moves"].append({"supplier_id": body["supplier_id"], "move": m, "reply": out})
            return out

        return act(request, body, fn)

    @app.post("/v1/sessions/{sid}/accept")
    def accept(request: Request, sid: str, body: dict):
        def fn(t):
            owner = next(
                (k for k, th in sim.session(t, sid)["threads"].items() if th["offer_id"] == body.get("offer_id")), ""
            )
            msg = {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": body.get("offer_id")}}
            return sim.message(t, sid, owner, msg)["result"]

        return act(request, body, fn)

    @app.post("/v1/sessions/{sid}/walk_away")
    def walk_away(request: Request, sid: str):
        def fn(t):
            sup = next(iter(sim.session(t, sid)["threads"]))
            return sim.message(t, sid, sup, {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}})["result"]

        return act(request, {}, fn)

    @app.get("/v1/leaderboard")
    def leaderboard(set: str = "practice"):
        with sim.lock:
            return sim.board()

    @app.get("/leaderboard", response_class=HTMLResponse)
    def leaderboard_html():
        with sim.lock:
            teams = sim.board()["teams"]
        rows = "".join(
            f"<tr><td>{t['rank']}</td><td>{html.escape(t['team_name'])}</td><td>{t['total']}</td></tr>" for t in teams
        )
        return f"<h1>arena-sim</h1><table>{rows}</table>"

    @app.get("/replay/{sid}")
    def replay(request: Request, sid: str):
        with sim.lock:
            s = sim.sessions.get(sid)
            if s is None or s["status"] != "ended":
                raise Fail(404, "no replay yet: the session is open")
            threads = {k: th["messages"] for k, th in s["threads"].items()}
            out = {"session_id": sid, "case_id": s["case"]["case_id"], "result": s["result"], "threads": threads}
            if "text/html" in request.headers.get("accept", ""):  # a browser: the same replay as a page
                return HTMLResponse(replay_html(out))
            return out

    return app


def load_cases(folder=CASES):
    found = (json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for p in sorted(Path(folder).glob("*.json")))
    return {c["case_id"]: c for c in found}


def main(argv=None):

1	"""The published cost function: what a term sheet costs the buyer in €, plus term helpers.
2	
3	C covers the buyer's fixed need over a fixed horizon: need the deal does not cover is bought at
4	the case's fallback price (plus the fallback risk of the category goal), committed volume is bought
5	needed or not, and units bought before a new price takes effect cost the current price. In
6	strategic and bottleneck cases a deal that leaves the supplier below a sustainable margin costs
7	too - pass your estimate of the supplier (`supplier_value`) to price that. Do the arithmetic here,
8	not in the language model.
9	"""
10	
11	import math
12	import operator
13	from datetime import date
14	
15	# Strategic and bottleneck goals: leaving the supplier below a sustainable margin costs.
16	RELATIONSHIP_GOALS = {"stabilise", "secure_supply"}
17	OPS = {
18	    "<=": operator.le,
19	    "<": operator.lt,
20	    ">=": operator.ge,
21	    ">": operator.gt,
22	    "==": operator.eq,
23	    "!=": operator.ne,
24	}
25	
26	
27	def closing_terms(case, terms, standard=None):
28	    """The terms a deal would close on: the term sheet, then the supplier's standard terms (from
29	    its quote PDF) for anything left out, then the case's fixed terms; gaps from the buyer's plan.
30	    """
31	    b = case["buyer"]
32	    freight = b["freight_eur_per_unit"]
33	    plan = {
34	        "volume_per_year": b["need_per_year"],
35	        "contract_months": round(12 * b["horizon_years"]),
36	        "payment_days": b["reference_payment_days"],
37	        "lead_time_days": b["need_lead_time_days"],
38	        # an unknown Incoterm counts as the costliest: a cautious buyer does not assume DAP
39	        "incoterm": max(freight, key=freight.get),
40	    }
41	    t = dict(plan)
42	    for layer in (standard or {}, case.get("fixed_terms", {}), terms):
43	        t.update({k: v for k, v in layer.items() if v is not None or k not in plan})
44	    return t
45	
46	
47	def horizon_start(case):
48	    """The horizon starts at the fixed or the earliest possible effective date."""
49	    fixed = case.get("fixed_terms", {}).get("effective_date")
50	    options = [o for o in case.get("term_options", {}).get("effective_date", []) if o]
51	    first = fixed or (min(options) if options else None)
52	    return date.fromisoformat(first) if first else None
53	
54	
55	def _years(case, t):
56	    """Years of the horizon a deal covers; a single order (0 months) counts as one year's lot.
57	    A commitment beyond the horizon neither costs nor earns."""
58	    months = t["contract_months"]
59	    return min(months / 12 if months else 1.0, case["buyer"]["horizon_years"])
60	
61	
62	def _units_before(case, t, years):
63	    """Units bought between the horizon start and the date a new price takes effect."""
64	    start = horizon_start(case)
65	    if not t.get("effective_date") or start is None:
66	        return 0.0
67	    lag = (date.fromisoformat(t["effective_date"]) - start).days / 365
68	    return t["volume_per_year"] * min(max(lag, 0.0), years)
69	
70	
71	def supplier_value(case, terms, supplier):
72	    """What a deal is worth to the supplier per unit, in cash: the price at its standard terms that
73	    would pay it the same. `supplier` is your estimate of it:
74	      standard       its standard terms (quote PDF, `docs.standard_terms`)
75	      interest_rate  what money now is worth to it per year (more to a supplier short of cash)
76	      usual_rate     its usual cost of money (default: interest_rate); tooling paid up front is
77	                     worth more to it when cash is dearer than usual
78	      ppm            the defect rate it really achieves (default: its standard ppm commitment)
79	      extra          EUR per unit it gains (+) or spends (-) beyond these items, e.g. overtime for
80	                     a faster delivery or idle capacity a larger volume fills (default 0)
81	    Contract length and an index clause are security, not cash: they do not count here."""
82	    b, std = case["buyer"], {**supplier["standard"], **case.get("fixed_terms", {})}
83	    t = closing_terms(case, terms, std)
84	    years = _years(case, t)
85	    sold = t["volume_per_year"] * years
86	    old = _units_before(case, t, years) / sold  # sold at the current price
87	    rate = supplier["interest_rate"]
88	    pay = 1 - rate * (t["payment_days"] - std["payment_days"]) / 360
89	    cash_now = 1 + (rate - supplier.get("usual_rate", rate)) * years / 2
90	    freight = b["freight_eur_per_unit"]
91	    ppm = supplier.get("ppm", std.get("ppm_commitment") or 0)
92	    return (
93	        t["unit_price"] * (1 - old) * pay
94	        + old * (b.get("current_unit_price") or 0.0) * pay
95	        + freight[t["incoterm"]]
96	        - freight[std["incoterm"]]  # it carries the freight leg
97	        + ((t.get("tooling_eur") or 0) - (std.get("tooling_eur") or 0)) / sold * cash_now
98	        - ppm / 1e6 * ((t.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0) - (std.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0))
99	        + supplier.get("extra", 0.0)
100	    )
101	
102	
103	def _soft(gap):
104	    """Margin points below the sustainable margin, as they cost: none above it, quadratic over
105	    the first 5 points, linear beyond - no kink."""
106	    if gap <= 0:
107	        return 0.0
108	    return gap * gap / 10 if gap <= 5 else gap - 2.5
109	
110	
111	def relationship_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None, value=None):
112	    """Strategic and bottleneck goals only: EUR for every margin point the deal leaves the supplier
113	    below `sustainable_margin_pct`, per year covered. `supplier["full_cost"]` (EUR per unit) is your
114	    estimate of its full cost; `value` overrides `supplier_value`. Without an estimate: 0."""
115	    b = case["buyer"]
116	    per_point, sustainable = b.get("relationship_eur_per_point"), b.get("sustainable_margin_pct")
117	    if b.get("category_goal") not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS or not per_point or not sustainable or not supplier:
118	        return 0.0
119	    t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
120	    worth = value if value is not None else supplier_value(case, t, supplier)
121	    margin = (worth - supplier["full_cost"]) / worth * 100
122	    return per_point * _soft(sustainable - margin) * _years(case, t)
123	
124	
125	def cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
126	    """C by part. `standard`: the supplier's standard terms for anything the term sheet leaves out.
127	    `supplier`: your estimate of the supplier for the relationship term (`supplier_value`)."""
128	    b, t = case["buyer"], closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
129	    if t.get("unit_price") is None:
130	        raise ValueError("no unit_price: a term sheet without a price has no cost")
131	    years = _years(case, t)
132	    committed = t["volume_per_year"] * years  # bought, needed or not
133	    covered = min(t["volume_per_year"], b["need_per_year"]) * years
134	    pre = _units_before(case, t, years)
135	    at_new_price = (committed - pre) * t["unit_price"]
136	    spend = pre * (b.get("current_unit_price") or t["unit_price"]) + at_new_price
137	    per_defect = b.get("cost_per_defect", 0)
138	    defect_cost = per_defect - min(t.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0, per_defect)
139	    index = index_risk = 0.0
140	    if clause := t.get("index_clause"):
141	        path = b.get("index_paths", {}).get(clause["series"], 0.0)
142	        moved = max(0.0, abs(path) - clause["deadband_pct"] / 100)
143	        index = at_new_price * clause["material_share"] * moved * math.copysign(1, path)
144	        index_risk = at_new_price * clause["material_share"] * b.get("index_risk_pct", 0) / 100
145	    uncovered = (b["need_per_year"] * b["horizon_years"] - covered) * b["fallback_unit_price"]
146	    need = b["need_lead_time_days"]
147	    return {
148	        "price": spend,
149	        "uncovered_need": uncovered,
150	        "fallback_risk": uncovered * b.get("fallback_risk_pct", 0) / 100,
151	        "payment_terms": spend * b["interest_rate"] * (b["reference_payment_days"] - t["payment_days"]) / 360,
152	        "freight": committed * b["freight_eur_per_unit"][t["incoterm"]],
153	        "late_delivery": b.get("late_cost_per_day", 0) * max(0, t["lead_time_days"] - need),
154	        "quality": committed * (t.get("ppm_commitment") or 0) / 1e6 * defect_cost,
155	        "tooling": t.get("tooling_eur") or 0.0,
156	        "index_clause": index,
157	        "index_risk": index_risk,
158	        "relationship": relationship_cost(case, t, supplier=supplier),
159	    }

162	def total_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
163	    """C in EUR; infinite for terms without a price (e.g. a supplier that quotes none), so such a
164	    sheet is never the cheapest and never beats an alternative."""
165	    if closing_terms(case, terms, standard).get("unit_price") is None:
166	        return math.inf
167	    return round(sum(cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard, supplier).values()), 2)

170	def score(c_open, c_deal, c_best):
171	    if c_deal is None:
172	        return 0.0
173	    if c_open - c_best <= 0.01:  # no room to negotiate: matching the best is full marks
174	        return 1.0 if c_deal <= c_best + 0.01 else 0.0
175	    return min(1.0, max(0.0, (c_open - c_deal) / (c_open - c_best)))

178	def must_haves_ok(case, terms, standard=None):
179	    t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
180	    for m in case["buyer"].get("must_haves", []):
181	        value = t.get(m["field"])
182	        if value is None and m["op"] not in ("==", "!="):
183	            return False
184	        if not OPS[m["op"]](value, m["value"]):
185	            return False
186	    return True

189	def snap(case, field, value):
190	    """The allowed value closest to `value` (case `term_options`), else `value` unchanged."""
191	    options = case.get("term_options", {}).get(field)
192	    if not options or value in options:
193	        return value
194	    if isinstance(value, int | float) and all(isinstance(o, int | float) for o in options):
195	        return min(options, key=lambda o: (abs(o - value), o))
196	    return options[0]

199	def complete_offer(case, terms):
200	    """A valid term sheet: exactly the negotiable fields, gaps from the buyer's plan, snapped."""
201	    plan = closing_terms(case, {"unit_price": None})
202	    freight = case["buyer"]["freight_eur_per_unit"]
203	    plan["incoterm"] = min(freight, key=freight.get)  # when asking, ask for the cheapest freight
204	    out = {}
205	    for field in case["negotiable"]:
206	        value = terms.get(field, plan.get(field))
207	        if value is None and case.get("term_options", {}).get(field):
208	            value = case["term_options"][field][0]
209	        value = snap(case, field, value)
210	        out[field] = round(value, 2) if field == "unit_price" and value is not None else value
211	    return out

376	
377	# Venue Wi-Fi drops. Retrying with the same move id makes the server return the reply it already
378	# gave instead of playing the move twice, so retries are safe even mid-negotiation.
379	MOVE_ID_HEADER = "X-Move-Id"
380	RETRY_STATUS = {429, 500, 502, 503, 504}
381	CALLS_PER_SECOND = 9  # the arena allows 10 per key; stay just below, across all threads
382	# A supplier's reply can take up to about a minute (its time does not count against your 60 s),
383	# and a call may wait for another call on the same session first: wait long enough for both.
384	TIMEOUT_S = 180.0
385	# Practice has a daily quota per team: every practice session start carries what is left in this
386	# header, and GET /v1/me tells where the team stands.
387	REMAINING_HEADER = "X-Practice-Remaining"
388	ME_PATH = "/me"
389	# A 429 with a short Retry-After is the per-second rate limit: wait and retry. Any other 429 (the
390	# practice quota, too many open sessions) does not go away by retrying.
391	MAX_RETRY_AFTER_S = 5

393	
394	class ArenaError(Exception):
395	    def __init__(self, status: int, detail):
396	        super().__init__(f"HTTP {status}: {detail}")
397	        self.status, self.detail = status, detail

400	class ArenaClient:
401	    def __init__(
402	        self,
403	        base_url=None,
404	        api_key=None,
405	        *,
406	        retries=3,
407	        transport=None,
408	        timeout=TIMEOUT_S,
409	        rate=CALLS_PER_SECOND,
410	    ):
411	        base_url = (base_url or os.environ.get("ARENA_URL", "")).rstrip("/")
412	        if not base_url:
413	            raise ValueError("set ARENA_URL (e.g. https://…) or pass base_url")
414	        key = api_key or os.environ.get("ARENA_API_KEY")
415	        headers = {"X-API-Key": key} if key else {}
416	        self.retries, self.rate, self._lock, self._next = retries, rate, threading.Lock(), 0.0
417	        self.practice_remaining = None  # from the last practice reply that said so
418	        self.http = httpx.Client(base_url=f"{base_url}/v1", headers=headers, timeout=timeout, transport=transport)
419	
420	    def _pace(self):
421	        with self._lock:
422	            now = time.monotonic()
423	            wait, self._next = self._next - now, max(now, self._next) + 1 / self.rate
424	        if wait > 0:
425	            time.sleep(wait)

427	    def _call(self, method, path, body=None, params=None, raw=False):
428	        headers = {MOVE_ID_HEADER: uuid.uuid4().hex} if method == "POST" else {}
429	        for attempt in range(self.retries + 1):
430	            self._pace()

432	                r = self.http.request(method, path, json=body, params=params, headers=headers)
433	            except httpx.TransportError:
434	                if attempt == self.retries:
435	                    raise
